presets.description: One directional warm source raking across the scene; deep falloff into near-black; controlled highlights on metal and stone; no fill flatness.
A single tall window casting a defined shaft of cool daylight into an otherwise dark interior; dust visible in the beam; warm practicals far in the background.
Low warm key as if from a single lamp or candle; intimate pooled light on the subject; the surroundings dissolving into shadow.
A restrained overhead pool of light on a table or floor; the upper architecture in shadow; solemn and ceremonial.
